inputs.text: ABU DHABI, 4th March, 2026 (WAM) -- The National Centre of Meteorology (NCM) has warned of active northwesterly winds affecting various areas across the UAE, expected to be fresh to strong at times, causing blowing dust and sand and reducing horizontal visibility to less than 2,000 metres in some coastal and inland areas. The centre stated that the expected weather conditions began at 14:55 and continue until 19:00 this evening. It urged members of the public to exercise caution, especially while driving on open roads, due to the possibility of reduced horizontal visibility caused by blowing dust.

payload.summary: I compared the Arabic headline, description and instruction with the English and found no difference in meaning. The hazard is the same: northwesterly fresh-to-strong winds raising dust and sand. The visibility threshold (under 2,000 metres), the areas (some coastal and inland), the end time (19:00 this evening, 4 March), the source (National Centre of Meteorology) and the URL all match. The protective action also matches: take extra care, especially when driving on open roads, rendered as توخَّوا مزيدًا من الحذر، لا سيما أثناء القيادة على الطرق المفتوحة. The Arabic was produced by machine translation, so a named person who reads Arabic must still verify and approve it before release. This check does not replace that review.
